source.author: verg
source.text: Hinc procul addit Tartareas etiam sedes, alta ostia Ditis, et scelerum poenas et te, Catilina, minaci pendentem scopulo Furiarumque ora trementem, secretosque pios, his dantem iura Catonem.
source.text_original: Hinc procul addit / Tartareas etiam sedes, alta ostia Ditis, / et scelerum poenas et te, Catilina, minaci / pendentem scopulo Furiarumque ora trementem, / secretosque pios, his dantem iura Catonem.
source.text_english: From here, too, he adds the Tartarean dwellings, the lofty gates of Dis, and the punishments of crimes, and you, Catilina, hanging from a menacing cliff and trembling at the faces of the Furies, and the secluded righteous, Cato, giving them laws.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_original: i, meus es, iam te in lucos pia turba silentum / secretisque ciet volitans pater Aeolus arvis.
reuse.text_english: Go, you are mine; already the dutiful band of the silent summons you to the groves, and Father Aeolus, flying about, calls you to the hidden fields.
